caption: The video captures a close-up of a metal tool and anvil assembly against a flat olive-green backdrop. A metallic tool dominates the upper center, its smooth cylindrical shank tapering into a worn conical tip pointing straight down. Beneath it rests a polished cylindrical metal anvil, its left rim marked by a small notch. Trapped between the cone tip and the anvil's top face is a pile of dark angular chunks mixed with lighter tan powder and scattered fine grains. The tip remains in continuous contact with the debris throughout, neither lifting away nor visibly flattening the pile. The fragments undergo only slight rearrangement, settling and spreading a touch as a few chunks shift in height. Small bright specks drift in and out of the air around the pile. The base, tool body, and background appear fixed, with the visible changes concentrated in the debris pile itself.
